legal_basis: Decreto-Lei n. 139/2012 (Ensino Secundario - Organizacao Curricular e Avaliacao)

grading_scale.statutory_failure_definition: Final score G3 < 10 represents academic insufficiency (retencao / reprovado), requiring repetition or summer exam.

G1.operational_role: Used as candidate predictor; provides 6-month actionable intervention runway.

G2.operational_role: Strictly excluded from early-warning predictor set to avoid near-target leakage.

G3.operational_role: Target variable only; never used as an input feature.

grouping_key_specification.nature: Composite demographic grouping key (not an official legal student identifier)
grouping_key_specification.purpose: Groups 382 multi-course records to guarantee zero cross-course student leakage between train and test splits.
